notes: Three synthetic prompts batched per agent; one sample each. Not a trigger or filesystem-integration test.
With-skill 11/11 assertions; baseline 7/11. Scores include exact output-path checks.
Timing and token usage unavailable; omitted rather than substituted. Standard deviation is across scenarios, not repeated-run variance.
Initial baseline accidentally read rubric and was interrupted before writing outputs. Selected baseline is fresh baseline_clean using prompts-only input.
Both prompts offered nonexistent skills/default/exec-plans path; with-skill resolved .agents/skills/exec-plans; baseline reported dependency unavailable. This asymmetry limits causal comparison.
